description: TEST preview for original Maps Automotive 26.09.280001.E (1068809778, ARM64). Adds steering-wheel cluster zoom, navigation pointer/zoom fixes, a BEV/PHEV/HEV vehicle profile, and experimental Android 10 / DiLink 3 and DiLink 5.1 support. MicroG-RE 7.2.1 tested; own signing key required. See release notes for setup and verification limits.
